def f2(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    n=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==n]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        for i in (r0,r1):
            if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in (c0,c1):
            if o[i][j]==bg: o[i][j]=2
    return o

def perp(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=n=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rs=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==n]; cs=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==n]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if o[i][j]==bg and ((i==r0 or i==r1) or (j==c0 or j==c1)): o[i][j]=2
    return o

def fills_of(k,Hm=None,Vm=None):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    f=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bgc and go[i][j]==2]
    hrows=sorted(set(i for i,j in f)); vcols=sorted(set(j for i,j in f))
    print(k,'bbox',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'nmark',len(pts))
    # minimal Hm covering all horiz fills: for each fill cell, is there a marker left/right in its row within... determine horiz by checking adjacent non-bg
    hf=[];vf=[]
    for i,j in f:
        l=gi[i][j-1] if j>0 else None; r_=gi[i][j+1] if j<W-1 else None
        if l==go[i][j] or r_==go[i][j] or (l!=bgc or r_!=bgc): hf.append((i,j))
        else: vf.append((i,j))
    print('  h:',len(hf),'v:',len(vf))
    print('  h rows:',hrows); print('  v cols:',vcols)
    # per-row max gap lengths among fills
    return hrows,vcols,f

G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 6']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    # fills
    fills=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bg and go[i][j]==2)
    print('==',k,'nmarks',len(pts),'bbox',(min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)),'nfills',len(fills))
    for j in sorted(set(j for _,j in fills)):
        iis=sorted(i for i in range(H) if gi[i][j]!=bg)
        g=[b-a-1 for a,b in zip(iis,iis[1:])]
        print(' col',j,'mkrows',iis,'fillrows',[i for i,_ in fills if _==i],'gaplen',g)
    for i in sorted(set(i for i,_ in fills)):
        js=sorted(j for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg)
        g=[b-a-1 for a,b in zip(js,js[1:])]
        print(' row',i,'mkcols',js,'fillcols',[j for _,j in fills if _==i],'gaplen',g)

G=load()
recs=[]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    for i in range(H):
        js=[j for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(js,js[1:]):
            gap=b-a-1
            filled=all(go[i][j]==2 for j in range(a+1,b))
            for tag in ('H' if i!=j else ''): pass
            recs.append((k,'H',i,a,b,gap,filled,i in (r0,r1),'near_edge' if c0<=a and b<=c1 else False))
    for j in range(W):
        ii=[i for i in range(H) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(ii,ii[1:]):
            gap=b-a-1
            filled=all(go[i][j]==2 for i in range(a+1,b))
            recs.append((k,'V',j,a,b,gap,filled,j in (c0,c1),'near_edge' if r0<=a and b<=r1 else False))
import collections
# summary per demo: for H fills, relation of gap size to filled
tab=collections.Counter()
for kk,side,i,a,b,gap,filled,_,_ in recs:
    if side=='H':
        tab[(kk,gap,filled)]+=1
print(tab)
